nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract, set to msg.sender at deployment.
Pending owner address, set in transferOwnership and consumed in acceptOwnership.
Token symbol, written in the RAZEN constructor.
Token name, written in the RAZEN constructor.
Token decimals, written in the RAZEN constructor.
Total token supply, assigned in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account balances, mutated by transfer/transferFrom/constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve/approveAndCall/transferFrom.
Internal helper performing addition guarded by require(c >= a).
Internal helper performing subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
Internal helper performing multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Internal helper performing division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Two-step ownership handover, requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor minting the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the balance of tokenOwner.
ERC20 transfer using safeSub/safeAdd on balances keyed by msg.sender.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without checks.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' deducting allowance of msg.sender.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval, an external untrusted call.
Payable fallback that always reverts.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer on an arbitrary token address.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance and allowance lookups.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval with attacker-chosen spender and data before returning.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary contract address.
Addition c = a + b in safeAdd; overflow mitigated only by require(c >= a).
Multiplication c = a * b in safeMul; overflow mitigated only by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf.
Local/return variable balance of balanceOf.
Destination address parameter 'to' of transfer.
Amount parameter 'tokens' of transfer.
Parameter spender of approve.
Amount parameter tokens of approve (allowance value written unchecked).
Debit address parameter 'from' of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter 'to' of transferFrom.
Amount parameter tokens of transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Local/return variable remaining of allowance.
Attacker-controlled spender contract parameter of approveAndCall.
Allowance amount parameter of approveAndCall, forwarded to the external call.
Arbitrary calldata parameter forwarded to receiveApproval.
Arbitrary external token contract address parameter.
Amount parameter of transferAnyERC20Token forwarded to external transfer.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from caller-controlled msg.sender.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner, caller controls the handover check.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner guard of transferOwnership is evaluated against msg.sender.
acceptOwnership authorization depends on msg.sender.
transferOwnership writes newOwner, which is later accepted as owner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets the fixed total supply.
Constructor mints the entire supply into balances of a hardcoded address.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer debits balances indexed by msg.sender.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
Caller identity selects the balance entry modified in transfer.
Caller identity selects the allowance entry written in approve/approveAndCall.
transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
transfer delegates deduction to safeSub.
transfer delegates crediting to safeAdd.
approve writes the allowance mapping without any validation.
transferFrom mutates balances of from and to.
transferFrom reduces the spender allowance.
transferFrom delegates balance and allowance deduction to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates crediting the recipient to safeAdd.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall is reachable by any caller via msg.sender allowance write before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes the external receiveApproval operation.
Untrusted spender contract can re-enter RAZEN functions during receiveApproval.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes the external token transfer operation.
The arbitrary token contract can re-enter during the external call.
onlyOwner guard of transferAnyERC20Token depends on msg.sender.
safeAdd executes the guarded addition a + b.
safeMul executes the guarded multiplication a * b.
_newOwner parameter is written into the newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
Local balance variable is returned by balanceOf.
Destination parameter decides which balance entry is credited.
tokens amount is subtracted via safeSub.
spender parameter selects the allowance key written by approve.
tokens parameter is stored verbatim as the allowance value.
from parameter selects the balance debited in transferFrom.
to parameter selects the balance credited in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is subtracted from balances and allowances via safeSub.
tokenOwner parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
Local remaining variable is returned by allowance.
spender parameter selects the allowance key in approveAndCall.
Attacker-chosen spender address becomes the external call target.
tokens parameter sets the allowance before the external call.
tokens parameter is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Arbitrary calldata is forwarded to the untrusted external contract.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the external call target.
tokens parameter is forwarded as the external transfer amount.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner flows directly into the newOwner state write of transferOwnership.
tokenOwner is only used as a lookup key inside balanceOf.
Return variable balance exists solely within balanceOf.
'to' is only consumed by the transfer function body.
'tokens' is only consumed by the transfer function body via safeSub/safeAdd.
spender is only used to index allowed inside approve.
tokens is only stored as the allowance value inside approve.
from is only used to index balances/allowed inside transferFrom.
to is only used to credit balances inside transferFrom.
tokens is only used as the transferred amount inside transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only a lookup key in allowance.
spender is only a lookup key in allowance.
Return variable remaining exists solely within allowance.
spender is used both as allowance key and as the target of the unsafe external call in approveAndCall.
tokens is written to allowance and forwarded to the external call in approveAndCall.
data is only forwarded to the untrusted external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress is used only as the target of the unsafe external call.
tokens is only forwarded to the external transfer call.
